stem: Which state is the largest ‘silk’ producing state ?
expl: According to year 2023-24 data, Karnataka is the leading producer of mulberry silk, with 44.15% of the total mulberry silk production of the country. It is notable that out of the total raw silk production in the country 41.69% is produced by the State of Karnataka.

stem: More than three-fourths of India's production of raw silk comes from –
expl: When the question was asked three- fourths of India’s total raw silk production came from Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Presently, 2023-24 these two states jointly account for more than 58.99% of the total raw silk production of the country.

expl: One of the rarest silks in the world is the Muga silk. In the year 2023-24 Assam (65.6%) and Meghalaya (16.67%) are the major producer of Muga silk.

stem: The discovery of Oak flora in 1966 added a new chapter to the history of Indian Sericulture. Which one of the following states is the leading producer of Oak Tasar silk?
expl: Jharkhand is currently the leading State to produce tasar silk in India. Tasar silk is divided into two categories namely tropical tasar and Oak tasar. Tropical tasar is produced the maximum in Jharkhand while Oak tasar is produced in Manipur. Hence, option (c) is the correct answer.

stem: Which of the following states of India is the largest producer of Silk Textiles ?
expl: Karnataka is the largest producer (in 2025) of silk garments in India.

stem: Which of the following States of India produces maximum silk yarn?
expl: Karnataka is the largest producer (in 2023-24) of silk yarn. However, India has the unique distinction of being the only country producing all the five kinds of silk namely Mulberry, Eri, Muga, Tropical Tasar and Temperate Tasar.
